title: A Theoretical Study on Bridging Internal Probability and Self-Consistency for LLM Reasoning
authors_zh: Zhi Zhou、Yuhao Tan、Zenan Li、Yuan Yao、Lan-Zhe Guo、Yu-Feng Li、Xiaoxing Ma（机构：南京大学软件新技术国家重点实验室、苏黎世联邦理工学院）
paper_type_zh: 测试时采样理论与高效推理研究
best_for_zh: 在有限推理采样数下设计置信度候选选择的读者。
one_line: RPC combines internal probability with self-consistency and prunes low-probability paths to reduce sampling cost in reasoning.
RPC 将内部概率与自一致性结合，并裁剪低概率路径以降低推理采样成本。
why: It gives both a theory and an implementation for spending fewer inference samples without reverting to a pure perplexity selector.
inclusion_reason: It reduces the sampling budget of test-time reasoning by combining candidate confidence estimation with low-probability path pruning.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Sampling-based reasoning improves an answer by generating several chains and choosing a candidate, but each extra chain consumes inference budget. Self-consistency aggregates answer frequency and is robust to path wording, yet its confidence estimate improves only gradually as samples increase. Perplexity instead uses the model's internal probability and can converge faster, but it scores whole paths in a way that may not respect the structure of the answer space and can select a fluent but wrong rationale.

The paper asks how to spend a limited number of reasoning samples while retaining reliable answer-level confidence. It frames the decision as more than producing many traces: the system must estimate which parsed answer is likely correct, decide which low-value paths no longer deserve computation, and avoid paying a large sample cost merely to make a majority vote stable.

采样式推理通过生成多条思维链并选择候选答案来提升结果，但每增加一条链都会消耗推理预算。自一致性聚合答案出现频率，对路径措辞较为稳健；但随着样本增加，它的置信度估计只能逐步改善。困惑度方法则使用模型的内部概率，能够更快收敛，却以不一定尊重答案空间结构的方式给整条路径评分，因而可能选择流畅但错误的推理。

论文研究如何在有限数量的推理采样下保留可靠的答案级置信度。它将问题视为不止要生成许多轨迹：系统还必须估计哪个解析出的答案更可能正确，决定哪些低价值路径不再值得消耗计算，并避免仅为使多数投票稳定而支付巨大的采样成本。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper analyzes sampling-based reasoning as confidence estimation and separates total reasoning error into estimation error and model error. This distinction explains a trade-off: self-consistency operates on parsed answers and keeps a favorable model-error property, but its Monte Carlo estimate has linear convergence; perplexity can exploit internal probability for faster convergence, but path-level probability creates a less suitable model-error term for answer selection.

RPC combines the two signals. Perplexity Consistency injects internal probability into answer-level self-consistency, while Reasoning Pruning removes low-probability paths that would otherwise weaken the convergence behavior. The resulting controller is meant to spend samples on a smaller, more informative candidate set rather than treating every generated rationale as equally valuable evidence.

论文将采样式推理分析为置信度估计，并把总推理误差拆分为估计误差和模型误差。这个区分解释了一项权衡：自一致性在解析后的答案上操作，保留了较好的模型误差性质，但其蒙特卡洛估计只有线性收敛；困惑度能够利用内部概率实现更快收敛，却因在路径层面使用概率，为答案选择带来较不合适的模型误差项。

RPC 将两类信号结合起来。困惑度一致性把内部概率注入答案级自一致性；推理裁剪则去除低概率路径，避免它们削弱收敛性质。这个控制器的目标是让采样预算投入更小、信息量更高的候选集合，而不是把每一条生成的推理都当作同等有价值的证据。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each prompt, the method samples multiple reasoning paths and parses them into candidate answers. Perplexity Consistency uses the language model's internal path probabilities together with answer agreement to score answer confidence. The paper shows that this combination can retain the answer-space advantage of self-consistency while improving the convergence behavior of the confidence estimate in the favorable regime.

Reasoning Pruning models the probability distribution of sampled paths and removes low-probability paths before final selection. The implementation exposes separate computations for self-consistency, perplexity, and RPC, plus data processing and evaluation scripts. The relevant inference record is therefore explicit: sampled trace, extracted answer, probability, consistency-derived confidence, pruning decision, and selected answer. No parameter update is required at deployment.

对每个提示，方法采样多条推理路径，并将它们解析为候选答案。困惑度一致性同时利用语言模型的内部路径概率和答案一致程度，为答案置信度评分。论文说明，在有利的条件下，这种结合既能保留自一致性处理答案空间的优势，也能改善置信度估计的收敛行为。

推理裁剪对采样路径的概率分布进行建模，并在最终选择前移除低概率路径。官方实现分别提供自一致性、困惑度与 RPC 的计算，以及数据处理和评测脚本。因此，推理时的关键记录是明确的：采样轨迹、抽取的答案、概率、一致性导出的置信度、裁剪决定和选中的答案。部署时不需要更新模型参数。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The NeurIPS paper reports theoretical analysis for self-consistency, perplexity, and RPC, then evaluates the method across seven benchmarks spanning mathematical, code, commonsense, and R1-style reasoning. The project and repository expose the reported method, data collection, and a demo. This is useful evidence because the proposed allocation rule is tested both as a confidence estimator and as a way to reduce actual model calls.

The reported result is that RPC can match self-consistency's reasoning performance with at least 50% less sampling budget on four mathematical datasets; under the same budget, the paper reports an average 1.29% improvement over the compared methods and improved confidence reliability. These figures depend on answer extraction, probability access, sample diversity, and the evaluation models, so a reproduction must compare equal total sample budgets rather than only the final accuracy number.

这篇 NeurIPS 论文针对自一致性、困惑度和 RPC 给出理论分析，随后在七个基准上评估方法，覆盖数学、代码、常识和 R1 风格推理。项目页与代码仓库公开了所报告的方法、数据集合和演示。这些证据有价值，因为所提出的分配规则既被作为置信度估计器检验，也被作为减少实际模型调用的方法检验。

论文报告，在四个数学数据集上，RPC 能以至少减少 50% 采样预算的方式达到自一致性的推理表现；在相同预算下，它相对于比较方法平均提升 1.29%，并提高置信度可靠性。这些数字依赖答案抽取、概率可得性、样本多样性与评测模型，因此复现时必须比较相同的总采样预算，而不能只比较最终准确率。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Many sampling methods either vote on answer frequency or rank complete paths by a likelihood-like score. RPC makes their distinct errors explicit and uses that analysis to design a hybrid. Its novelty is not simply adding another candidate score: it assigns internal probability to answer-level agreement, then explicitly prunes the paths that would make the favorable convergence argument fail.

The paper also pairs this construction with an auditable public implementation containing separate baseline computations. This makes the inference-time decision inspectable at the level of path scores and pruning, rather than presenting an opaque reward model. The contribution is therefore a theoretical account of a test-time allocation trade-off and a concrete policy for reducing the number of expensive reasoning samples.

许多采样方法要么按答案出现频率投票，要么用类似似然的分数给完整路径排序。RPC 明确揭示两者不同的误差来源，并据此设计混合方法。它的新意不只是添加一个候选分数：它把内部概率赋予答案级一致性，再显式裁剪那些会使有利收敛论证失效的路径。

论文还配套发布可审计的公开实现，其中包含彼此独立的基线计算。这使推理时决策能够在路径分数和裁剪层面被检查，而不是呈现为一个不透明的奖励模型。因此，该工作同时贡献了对测试时分配权衡的理论解释，以及一项减少昂贵推理样本数量的具体策略。

title: Limitations
局限
html: RPC requires access to meaningful internal model probabilities and reliable parsing from free-form rationales to answers; it is therefore less direct for closed APIs or tasks with ambiguous answer semantics. Pruning can discard a low-probability path that is nevertheless correct, and its benefit depends on diverse samples rather than many correlated copies. The theory also abstracts away some deployment costs, such as probability extraction and answer-equivalence caching.
RPC 需要获得有意义的模型内部概率，并需要可靠地把自由形式推理解析为答案；因此，它对封闭接口或答案语义含糊的任务不够直接。裁剪可能丢弃概率低却实际正确的路径，其收益也依赖多样化样本，而不是许多彼此高度相关的副本。理论还抽象掉了一些部署成本，例如概率抽取和答案等价性缓存。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use RPC when repeated reasoning samples are available, internal token probabilities can be queried, and sample count is an important serving budget. Record the raw paths, answer parser output, probability values, confidence estimates, pruning rate, total calls, and accuracy. Compare against self-consistency at matched total calls and check calibration as well as accuracy, because the method claims to improve the quality of the decision signal rather than only the final vote.
当能够获得重复推理样本、可以查询内部令牌概率，而且样本数是重要服务预算时，可以使用 RPC。应记录原始路径、答案解析器输出、概率数值、置信度估计、裁剪率、总调用次数和准确率。应在相同总调用次数下与自一致性比较，并同时检查校准性和准确率，因为该方法声称改善的是决策信号质量，而不只是最终投票。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Pay attention to the level at which each signal is defined: self-consistency aggregates parsed answers, whereas perplexity begins from individual paths. The paper's main claim follows only after that distinction is preserved in the estimator and in the pruning rule. When reusing the code, audit the answer parser and the low-probability threshold first; these two choices determine whether the reported sample savings transfer to a new domain.
阅读时应关注每种信号定义在哪个层面：自一致性聚合解析后的答案，而困惑度从单条路径开始。只有在估计器和裁剪规则中保留这种差异，论文的主要论证才成立。复用代码时，应先审计答案解析器和低概率阈值；这两个选择决定报告的采样节省能否迁移到新领域。
